look_here_first: Look for the mostly unlobed to shallowly toothed, leathery evergreen to semi-evergreen leaves. The acorn cup is deeper than in Shumard oak and may enclose roughly half the nut.

key_traits.text: evergreen to semi-evergreen oak in cultivation

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves usually unlobed or shallowly toothed rather than deeply lobed

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: cup hemispheric to funnel-shaped and relatively deep

key_traits.label: Identification

lookalikes.differences: Use as a common landscape comparison against local native oaks; do not interpret planted Central Texas specimens as native occurrences.
